body:
Built CsrMatrix/csr-from-coo/csr-nnz/csr-get/csr-matvec in linalg.prn, real COO->CSR conversion + O(nnz) sparse matvec. Found and worked around a real, pre-existing loop-variable/Vec-I32 boxing bug on the critical path (as-i32 workaround), and fixed a separate real gap in inverse/solve (undefined LinalgError, never-gcc-verified body-less stubs). make test: 347/347. Commit 749a399.

⚓ ☃
title: Real CSR sparse-matrix primitives shipped (csr-from-coo/get/matvec)
